title: Core Awakening
tagline: Rebuild your identity from the remnants of fallen Titans.
pitch: Engage in tactical arena combat as a modular mech, dismantling enemies to recover valuable components. Every decision shapes your power and identity while you uncover your past.
coreLoop: Read enemy attack telegraphs, evade or interrupt strikes, target subsystems, and defeat foes to salvage or repair your mech. Your choices directly impact your capabilities.

mechanics.name: Tactical Combat
mechanics.description: Dodge and manipulate enemy attacks while targeting specific subsystems for a strategic advantage.

mechanics.name: Subsystem Targeting
mechanics.description: Choose which enemy part to attack; destroying an enemy's weapon offers safety but loses the chance to salvage it.

mechanics.name: Three-Way Decision
mechanics.description: After defeating an enemy, make a quick choice to install, secure, or dismantle the recovered component.

controls.keyboard: WASD for movement, mouse for aiming

difficulty.progression: enemy patterns become more complex, requiring quicker decisions
difficulty.peak: challenging timing for dodges and critical targeting decisions

winLose.win: defeat the enemy and make a successful three-way decision
winLose.lose: fail to evade or interrupt and take critical damage

juice.particles: when components are salvaged or installed

scopeNotes: No procedural dungeons, no character upgrades, no multiple enemy types, no inventory management, no narrative scenes beyond one line.

scoreEvents: score increases on enemy defeated, successful subsystem targeted, and component decisions made
